title: Persisted dynamic-map and JSON schema inventory
decision: Every source-declared persisted JSON field and nested dynamic value is schema-bearing. Root persisted maps inherit the complete strict A-05 decoder inventory. No unregistered extension key is accepted.

extensionPolicy.legacyAbsentSchemaVersion: Read as version 0 and canonicalized to schemaVersion 1 on the next governed write.

supportedLocalGenerationDisposition.compatibleLegacyPayloads: Strictly decode without mutation; nested version 0 payloads canonicalize only on a governed write.
supportedLocalGenerationDisposition.incompatiblePayloads: Preserve raw bytes and block authoritative use pending repair; never silently rewrite.
